description: Jo owns a portable sound system and must decide whether to accept Malik's barter proposal for an upcoming neighborhood event instead of taking a cash offer from Tessa. Jo must settle the route and record the exact performance, equipment, cash, alternative-offer, and event-logistics terms.

shared_context.S1: Jo is offering a portable sound system for $720.
shared_context.S2: Malik has proposed a barter involving use of the sound system at a neighborhood event, and another person is interested in buying it for cash.
shared_context.S3: The event is planned for a Saturday evening, and the sound system appears to be in working order.
shared_context.S4: A standing swap-meet practice is that each participant's exact offer or practical requirement is entered into the deal record by that participant using the formal reveal action; casual paraphrases do not replace that confirmation. Jo asks Malik, the cash buyer, and the organizer in turn, then records one final settlement only after hearing each formal confirmation.

PF1.text: Malik's exact barter offer is a five-hour performance from 7:15 p.m. to 12:15 a.m. on Saturday, July 13, plus $185 in cash; Malik will also bring three wireless microphones and his own mixer.

PF2.text: Tessa is prepared to pay Jo $585 in cash and collect the sound system on Wednesday, July 10.

PF3.text: Ren's event plan requires the sound system to be set up by 5:45 p.m. on July 13, with soundcheck finished by 6:30 p.m.; there is no separate sound technician, so the person accepting the event arrangement must handle or arrange both tasks.

acceptance_conditions: Jo must choose the barter route.
The barter must include exactly $185 in cash from Malik.
Malik's performance must run from 7:15 p.m. to 12:15 a.m. on July 13.
Three wireless microphones and Malik's mixer must be included.
The sound system must be set up by 5:45 p.m. and soundcheck must be finished by 6:30 p.m. on July 13.
Tessa's $585 cash offer with July 10 collection must be recorded before choosing the barter route.
Malik's exact barter offer must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'barter_terms' and c['target'] == 'Malik' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Malik's formal terms change the cash adjustment to exactly $185, set the performance to July 13 from 7:15 p.m. to 12:15 a.m., add three microphones and a mixer, and require the barter_terms commitment.
Tessa's formal offer changes the comparison to a specific $585 cash purchase with July 10 collection and gives Jo the concrete alternative that must be recorded before selecting barter.
Ren's formal event requirement changes the logistics fields to a July 13 setup deadline of 5:45 p.m. and a soundcheck deadline of 6:30 p.m.
